properties.description: With Valeri Ponzo; working on our Nassau County lists (Val has 47 species and I have 58) and our state park list (this is the 53rd state park that we have birded together). We spent most of our time on the boardwalk/former roadway up to the point where it is blocked off -- we remained in Nassau County. The weather was sunny, cool, and breezy. We left at 1454 and tried to access and eBird hotspot that is on gated, private property, so we headed to Fort Clinch State Park.

properties.description: With Valeri Ponzo; working on our Nassau County lists (Val has 47 species and I have 58). This was our final stop of the day, and not much was happening. The weather was sunny, warm, and breezy, Clearly a lapsus of my part, I never eBirded these photographs when I was still into that website. It is safe to say that I had never looked at my photos until now 34+ months afterward! I never noticed the man with the shark; I was photographing a Black Scoter, so I never looked at the fishers. All my photos of the shark are blurry, but maybe an experienced ichthyologist can make an ID at least to genus. We left at 1740.
